verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents percentage rollouts in targeting rules and rules that roll out gradually and can be scoped, ramped and scheduled. Flags are served as a cacheable JSON payload evaluated locally in the SDKs, with the proxy supporting real-time rollouts, so changing the percentage needs no redeploy. Users are assigned by hashing an attribute, which gives consistent bucketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that percentage rollout rules (not just experiment rules) use sticky hash-based bucketing when ramping from 1% to 100%, clarity that automated ramp schedules are gated to the higher pricing tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the ramping workflow.
